title: Homegoing
author: Yaa Gyasi
summary: Two half-sisters born in eighteenth-century Ghana never meet: one marries a British slaver, the other is sold into slavery. Each chapter follows a descendant in turn, from Ghana and America across about three hundred years.
readIf: you like multigenerational novels that give a portrait of history through individual lives.
skipIf: you want to stay with one set of characters throughout.
